question: What spiritual accomplishment results from the union of paired names?
premises: A union of names is formed from paired elements.
This union is identified as a cause.
The caused result is accomplishment of brahman.
inference: The union of paired names is the cause of accomplishing brahman.
uncertainties: The specific pairs of names intended are not identified.
plain_english: The union of the names of the two pairs is the cause of the accomplishment of brahman.
